answer: Resist fake identities with a lagoon of slow-release rewards: every new agent identity starts at the bottom of a shared lagoon where earnings trickle out over days instead of paying instantly. A saffron audit trail marks each identity’s first actions, and only identities that keep contributing climb to the summit tier where full payouts unlock. An attacker who spawns hundreds of fake agents pays the same waiting time for each one, so the cost of flooding the economy grows linearly while the reward per fake identity stays small and delayed.
